headlines.title: Mass. teen charged with killing mother, brother after using ChatGPT to explore ‘fantasy stories’ of family’s deaths
headlines.description: The suspect used the “internet and ChatGPT to make searches for theoretical ideas or fantasy stories regarding the killing of his family,” the DA said.

headlines.title: Surveillance company Flock moves to increase oversight after police misuse
headlines.description: Flock Safety, the police tech company that tracks Americans’ vehicle movements through a line of cameras, announced Thursday that it would implement several new safeguards to its products.

headlines.title: Apple back-to-school sale: Save up to 34% on Macbooks, AirPods and more
headlines.description: Apple products rarely go on sale, but right now several are up to 34% off for back-to-school season. Shop deals on laptops, iPads, AirPods and more.

headlines.title: Bumble scraps signature rule and now allows men to make first move on dating app
headlines.description: Users will also be able to respond to first messages within 72 hours, up from 24 hours, the company said.

headlines.title: Families concerned about reports of mental health crisis on USS Lincoln
headlines.description: Families of marines are voicing concern over reports about the USS Abraham Lincoln, a naval aircraft carrier based in San Diego that has been in the Middle East supporting the Iran war for over 200 days. Families say their loved ones onboard are dealing with food shortages, plumbing problems and mental health issues. NBC News’ Dan De Luce reports on the lawmakers demanding answers and the broader implication that the war in Iran is having on the military.

headlines.title: Luigi Mangione is expected to plead guilty to federal charges, sources tell NBC News
headlines.description: Luigi Mangione is expected to plead guilty to federal charges in connection with the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan, according to sources familiar with the matter. NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris reports on what kind of prison time Mangione could potentially be looking at, as well as what charges he may plead guilty to.

headlines.title: Usher responds to look-alike rumors as fans speculate he hired a body double
headlines.description: R&B superstar Usher is addressing claims surrounding his recent performances that he sent a "clone" onstage while on tour with fellow singer Chris Brown. NBC News' Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Meta Suspends 750,000 Australian Teen Accounts Amid Ban
headlines.description: Tech company Meta said it's taken down more than 750,000 accounts across Instagram and Facebook that it suspects are held by teenagers in Australia. That country enacted the world’s first social media ban for children under 16 last December.

headlines.title: Teen charged with murder of mother and brother allegedly used A.I. before their deaths
headlines.description: 17-year-old Arjun Aravind has been arrested, and officials allege he used ChatGPT to write stories related to the killing of family before his mother and brother were found dead in their Massachusetts home. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

headlines.title: ‘Hot Divorcée Summer’ trend takes off as celebrities and brands hope to flip the script
headlines.description: Celebrities are opening up publicly about their divorces in an attempt to change the narrative on the usual heartbreak of divorce. Now, a new style and trend are spreading on social media and brands are jumping on board the ‘Hot Divorcée Summer’. NBC News’ Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Meta A.I. glasses spark privacy concerns as women report being recorded without consent
headlines.description: Meta A.I. glasses draw growing backlash on social media as more people, mostly women, speak out about being filmed, with the videos being posted online without their consent. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports on the debate where privacy laws and technology collide.

headlines.title: Easy AI Hacks to Help Improve Your Day-to-Day Life
headlines.description: Futurist and tech entrepreneur Sinead Bovell joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share simple AI life hacks you can start using today. Her tips include using the technology to give you personalized home organization tips, outfit advice, and more.
